review.algorithm_assessment: A low-bit-first binary trie stores subtree values with multiplicity parity and XOR. Moving a child subtree one edge upward increments every stored value: swap low-bit branches and propagate carry only through the old1 branch. Destructive trie merge combines child multisets, then insert local value. Aggregate XOR yields val(u); iterative tree order and compact arrays support deep trees without graph recursion.
review.limitations: One source reviewer plus actual isolated tests, not independent dual semantic review.
